name: JKCS 041 (Hubble)
blurb: JKCS 041, a distant galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: jkcs041-hubble
story: JKCS 041 is a rich cluster in the distant universe, where most member galaxies had already stopped forming stars. Hubble came to see how their crowded surroundings shaped the growth of its compact galaxies.

claims.text: JKCS 041 is a rich, distant galaxy cluster
Most confirmed members are quiescent (no longer forming stars)
HST program 12927 studies the role of the environment in the growth of compact red galaxies in JKCS041
JKCS041-1 is one of the program's pointings on the cluster
